import pathlib,json,re
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
r=pathlib.Path.cwd();refs={}
for n in ['t02_gate_first_cpu_01','diag_look_census_extension_black_guard_04','diag_additional_look_a_black_guard_01','diag_additional_look_b_black_guard_01','diag_g01_next12_early_preflight_01']:
 d,ref=audited_result(r/'results'/f'{n}.json');assert d['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and d['metrics']['command_exit_code']==0;refs[n]=ref
test=json.loads((r/'results/t02_gate_first_cpu_01.json').read_text());log=(r/test['_meta']['log_path']).read_text();assert re.search(r'Ran 16 tests in ',log) and '\nOK\n' in log
c,cr=audited_result(r/'results/t02_look_additional_c01.json');row=c['metrics']['pairs'][0]
assert row['pair_id']=='floorplan301_00083' and row['table_complete'] and row['native_evidence_verified'] and row['rejection_reasons']==[] and row['cleanup_errors']==[]
records=[]
for folder in [
'pilot_pairs_v2_look_table_fp204_extension01_retry2-20261109T103157Z-033e7e1a',
'pilot_pairs_v2_look_table_fp204_extension01_retry3-20261109T104652Z-6ae1c349',
'gen_train_next12_60_01_retry1-20261109T103428Z-92485134',
'pilot_pairs_v2_look_additional_a01-20261109T103720Z-a9c653e4',
'pilot_pairs_v2_look_additional_b01-20261109T103933Z-dbe1cf85',
'pilot_pairs_v2_look_additional_c01-20261109T104232Z-2a832d74']:
 f=r/'logs/pbs'/folder;p=json.loads((f/'payload.json').read_text());s=json.loads((f/'submission.json').read_text())
 assert s['returncode']==0
 records.append({'name':p['name'],'job_id':s['stdout'].strip(),'retry_of':p['retry_of'],'receipt':str(f.relative_to(r))})
with (r/'STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write('\n### Render-gate ordering and continued night work\n\nCommitted ef72cf0 moves only the complete T02 source-authentication block after a successful, clean render gate and before every export Worker. All original source/scientific checks and deadlines remain unchanged; t02_gate_first_cpu_01 passes16 CPU tests, including black/ordinary gate stops, uncertain cleanup, and no first Worker when a later source fails. Previous jobs had source authentication before the gate; future unusable allocations now stop before that CPU work. Current original T02 parents had ended before deployment. Additional groupC708245 produced an ended original complete/native-verified no-non_anchor_divergent report for floorplan301_00083, pending formal census authentication; actual0.065GPUh/187s queue, no cache or training authorization. A708241 and B708242 stopped on black gates with zero exported pairs. FP204 extension chain708196 ->708217 ->708235 ->708258 also remains black-only/unstarted; all failed originals/strict native proofs retained before same-scope retry.\n\nG01 next12 retry708238 passed its gate and continues under the existing10-minute snapshot procedure. FP8/9/205 were excluded by their original initial-settling displacement>0.5m checks before any proposal; inventory stayed exact. This matches supplement6 known exclusions, not a search regression. Specific original moved objects and SHA checks are in diag_g01_next12_early_preflight_01; thresholds/reference snapshots remain unchanged, and future scene selection avoids repeatedly scheduling these known exclusions. The normal hopper22 job708071 and black hopper22 job708241 used different GPU UUIDs; existing Unity/Vulkan logs share H200/595.112.07 and show no conclusive driver/root-cause error. GPU UUID and each actual native frame remain recorded; do not classify whole nodes as bad. Latest conditional next-scene recommendation is diag_g01_next_scene_plan_01, to be considered after current independent validation and budget checks.\n')
print('NIGHT_GATE_ORDER_AND_MAPPING_JSON: '+json.dumps({'checks':refs,'completed_C':cr,'submissions':records},sort_keys=True))
